reason: Unofficial external-service integration that signs into Cursor, retrieves model and usage data, and routes chat through private Cursor endpoints; the README explicitly warns of Terms of Service violations and possible account bans, requiring human review.

summaries.zh: 通过非官方 Cursor 登录、模型目录和聊天接口，将 Cursor 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Cursor through unofficial sign-in, model catalog, usage, and chat endpoints.

capabilities: stores a local Cursor session credential
accesses private Cursor service endpoints over HTTP/2
retrieves available models and usage information
sends chat requests through Cursor AgentService
